office_does: The assessor sets the market value of every taxable property in the county each year, the basis for property tax bills, and runs the senior, disability and open-space exemption programs.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Jim Ruud (Prefers Republican Party), assessor for 20 years by his statement, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Douglas County Assessor for 20 years by his statement and a real estate managing broker; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Assessor for 20 years, by his statement [S1]
